en: A black-and-white nighttime photograph of a grand historic building with elaborate baroque or neo-renaissance architecture. The building is well-lit, highlighting its statues, columns, and ornate façade. In the foreground, there are several vintage cars and old-fashioned street lamps, indicating a historical period. There is a quadriga (four-horse chariot) statue on top of the central entrance.
